 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 0]
    zr = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in zr), max(r for r,c in zr)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in zr), max(c for r,c in zr)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(tr1-tr0+1):
        for c in range(tc1-tc0+1):
            out[tr0+r][tc0+c] = grid[r0+r][c1-c]
    return out
